title: Circle or square?
topic: A beginner p5.js activity that uses random() and if/else to fill a grid with circles or  nested squares.
summary:
A one-sheet mini-zine that walks beginners through a p5.js sketch: set up a canvas, build 
a grid with nested loops, then let random() choose a circle or a nested square.

intake.maintainer_notes:
Three language editions exist (Turkish, English, French). The attached reader-order and 
print-ready PDFs are the full-color English edition (`read-en.pdf`, `print-en.pdf`).

Additional files include full-color reader-order and print-ready PDFs for Turkish and 
French (`read-tr.pdf`, `read-fr.pdf`, `print-tr.pdf`, `print-fr.pdf`), and `bw.zip` 
containing black-and-white reader-order and print-ready PDFs for all three languages 
(`read-bw-en.pdf`, `read-bw-tr.pdf`, `read-bw-fr.pdf`, `print-bw-en.pdf`, `print-bw
tr.pdf`, `print-bw-fr.pdf`) for grayscale or non-color printing.

Typography in the PDFs uses Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono (SIL Open Font License).

activity_type: Self-guided activity; also works as a short workshop or classroom exercise.
materials:
- A computer with a web browser
- The p5.js Web Editor (editor.p5js.org), or Processing in p5.js mode
- Optional, for the paper zine: a printer, one sheet of A4 paper, and scissors
